def merge_sort(arr: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr[:]
    mid = len(arr) // 2
    left = merge_sort(arr[:mid])
    right = merge_sort(arr[mid:])
    res = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            res.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            res.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    return res + left[i:] + right[j:]

arr = [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10]
print(merge_sort(arr))
